text: when i do this it causes program to freeze and need kill -9 to exit: texture atlas -> uniform pack all islands -> collect same orientation -> stitch; actually, it seems also after resetting it did the edit but it froze the app before so
resolution: Fixed the freeze in Uniform Pack All Islands → Collect Same Orientation → Stitch. The old sweep repeatedly rebuilt topology and compared every remaining island against every fixed island, producing cubic growth. Stitch now builds boundary topology once, indexes only unambiguous two-owner seam relations, and evaluates reachable pairs once through a priority heap. Added a 6,831-island regression that completes in about 0.07 seconds plus a many-owner pole refusal, then passed the editor bundle and ReleaseFast build.
